editorial.blurb: Coda di Volpe brings authentic Neapolitan pizzas and housemade pastas to Chicago with surprising elegance and genuine warmth.
editorial.insiderTip: Snag a patio seat on a nice day and order the octopus to start—it's charred to perfection and sets the tone for the meal. Ask your server about seasonal pasta specials, which rotate and deserve a visit on their own.
